items.title: Personal Website
items.blurb: What you're looking at right now!

details.text: I built this website to showcase my projects and experiences, and to give myself some visibility. I used Astro and React to build the website. I primarily used Cursor as an AI tool to stand up the website before I iterated on the design. A lot of the purpose was to continue learning more AI tooling methodologies while updating my personal site!

items.title: Search NEU
items.blurb: Student-built search engine for Northeastern University classes.

details.text: Search NEU is a student-built search engine for Northeastern University classes. Search NEU helps students better navigate classes with a significantly more accessible UI/UX over the old Banner system. It has an automated scrape process for thousands of clasess, supports undergraduate and gradute courses, and has a text-based notification system for class openings. It's a long lived project, with close to 8 years of development and maintenance by students. In my Seinor year I was the project lead, organizing Agile workflows and leading technical development of Class Pages.

items.title: FirstByte
items.blurb: Student led STEM education program for primary school students.

details.text: While not technical, I'm proud of my time as the project leader of FirstByte's curriculum team, which created a variety of STEM curriculums for primary school students. Specifically, I worked on creating scratch curriculums for students to learn about programming and basic computer science concepts, interfacing with hardware for engaging interactability!
